appearance.identity: Roman Antalya tower with17.2x17.3m square podium,15.8m round drum, northeast Ionic entrance with twelve fasces, blocked northwest doorway, projecting cornices, open roof around central pedestal, twelve northern merlons and higher southern defensive infill with a real window. Current Turkish flag and pole complete the exterior.
appearance.master: Preserve the77044triangle detailed source and imported master unchanged.

Detailed source masters are preserved. Browser ashlar and tiny fittings aggregate with distance; the vector national flag retains the crescent and star on both sides. Vegetation, exact weathering, interiors and transient equipment are excluded. Physical-device timings remain pending.
